body: There is a `MatchCase` icon that this can use.

There is already a limit of 100000 per file, we probably shouldn't have 2 separate limits.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1aaea38e7f8dd9e2a94e2e339247fc976a84de75/editor/script/find_in_files.cpp#L236-L238

If we do add this, there should be a way to disable it too, like if it is set to -1.
Related https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4717


Also it feels like does not work correctly, it will never show that it is finished searching and it looks like it is stuck. It should instead show a warning that there are too many matches instead, and that the limit can be increased or the search can be more specific.

But I don't think there needs to be a new result limit field in this PR, the search happens asynchronously so you can still use the editor already. It doesn't matter how long it takes since there is a clearly visible search progress bar and a cancel button. IMO this is already far better usability than the demo from https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5544#issuecomment-1847419681 that just has a popup and no progress to completion or cancel.
If we are concerned about performance, we can improve it in multiple ways in a separate PR. Such as multithreading (see the `// This part can be moved to a thread if needed.`), or not using signals to update the ui immediately for every single find.

I'm not completely against a global result limit. But IMO it should be big enough that you generally don't need to care about it. And ideally it would only have to be a editor setting.

clear is much more common than using reset, I don't think this needs a complete reset of memory.

> This should probably switch to the new panel if there is one without changes instead of always allowing new ones to be made.

Not sure what you mean with this. Do you mean it should switch to a panel without any changes (everything in the state when currently creating a new panel) instead of making a new one?

The concern was also that too many results will cause the results `Tree` to start lagging https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5544#issuecomment-1732529982. But I think it would be better to address this in a follow up PR in case there are problems. I will remove it for now

Yes. I was comparing it to the new scene button, where if you click it and you already have a new scene open, it switches instead of making a new one. 
It's not necessary to prevent making a new one, but I don't think there is much reason to make a new search if you already have a new search open.
Not sure how to best determine what a new search is considering they inherit properties though.

I am not sure if this is intuitive behavior I can see people being confused by trying to create a new tab, seeing it sometimes "does not work" and reporting it as a bug. At least I can imagine myself being in this situation. I suggest we leave this out for now
